ambient_events: Silt has drifted into a soft grey bank against the dead end, hiding whatever it hides.
The water here barely moves; it just sits and thinks.
A coin-bright glint winks from the muck, then thinks better of it.
description: A blind pocket off the sluice line where the current dies and everything it was carrying settles out. Years of silt have built a soft bank across the back wall, and the streets above have quietly posted their losses into it the whole time. A patient searcher does well in a dead end like this.
name: Silt Pocket
